Sam (AE): TrustBank vendor team flagged the SIG follow-up: they need verifiable proof that admin console changes, API key rotation, and emergency access are logged, plus proof exported logs are immutable for 12 months. Can we put together an evidence packet for the POC within 48h?

Noor (SE): Yes. We'll produce a compact bundle: sample audit.jsonl, manifest.sha256, PGP-signed manifest, Splunk HEC + syslog-TLS example configs, and a short runbook for verification. Hosted retention = 90d by default; to meet 12mo we'll recommend continuous forwarding or periodic export to customer S3 with object-lock=COMPLIANCE and their KMS.

Alex (Security): Scope note: include these event types explicitly: admin.ui.update_policy, admin.role.grant, api.key.rotate, emergency.access.grant, iam.assume_role (impersonation). We'll redact PII by default and include an appendix showing original vs redacted lines. We'll sign the manifest and include fingerprint in the attestation.

Priya (TrustBank Sec): They want to see an export operator recorded (who started the export) and a job id in the export logs, and prefer Splunk as the collector. Also need wording comparing COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE object-lock semantics.

Noor (SE): Example audit lines we'll include in the bundle (redacted where required):

{"ts":"2026-06-10T11:02:45Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-cc7f2","range":"2026-06-01..2026-06-10"}
{"ts":"2026-06-10T11:04:12Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"api.key.rotate","target":"svc-ledger","ip":"203.0.113.21","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2026-06-10T11:05:03Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"admin.role.grant","target":"group-ops","reason":"approved-change"}
{"ts":"2026-06-10T11:06:10Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.complete","job_id":"job-cc7f2","artifact":"bundle-20260610.zip"}

Noor (SE): Splunk HEC example to put in runbook (minimal):

curl -sS https://splunk.trustbank.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-06-10T11:04:12Z","actor":"admin@trustbank.com","action":"api.key.rotate","resource":"svc-ledger"}}'

Noor (SE): Syslog/TLS example (rsyslog forwarder snippet):

*.* @@(o)logs.trustbank.com:6514;RSYSLOG_SyslogProtocol23Format

Alex (Security): For immutability proof: export -> push to customer-owned S3 bucket with object-lock COMPLIANCE + customer-managed KMS is our recommended pattern. We'll provide manifest.sha256 with per-file SHA256 entries and a PGP signature: manifest.sha256.sig. The attestation PDF will state scope, date-range, fields redacted, and the PGP fingerprint for verification.

Priya (TrustBank Sec): Can you include a short CLI snippet for verification steps we can hand the vendor team?

Noor (SE): Sure:
# verify hashes
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
# verify PGP signature
gpg --verify manifest.sha256.sig manifest.sha256

Alex (Security): Redaction appendix will show before/after examples and note that exports can be configured to include full identifiers under NDA. We'll include the redaction policy reference and contact: security@redwood.com.

ArtifactBot: export job queued for 1819002468 - collecting events (2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-10) ETA ~50m

Sam (AE): Good. I'll tell TrustBank we'll deliver a bundle and attestation within 48h and offer a quick verification call.

ArtifactBot: export slice ready (1819002468/slice-2026-06-10.zip) - files: slice.jsonl (320KB), slice.sha256 - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1819002468/slice-2026-06-10.zip

Priya (TrustBank Sec): Received the slice. I see api.key.rotate entries. I'll loop in our vendor-risk reviewer to run the hash check.

Noor (SE): Adding a short runbook blurb about chain-of-custody: each export records operator + job_id, the bundle gets a SHA256 manifest, we sign the manifest with our PGP key, and when placed into customer object-lock storage the customer can demonstrate files are immutable for the retention window. We'll include sample language for their vendor documentation.

Alex (Security): Attestation draft: 'Redwood Inference confirms the attached artifacts are exports from the hosted tenant (ID:tn-XXXX) covering 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-10. Fields marked as redacted were masked per Redwood redaction policy v2.2. Manifest was signed by security@redwood.com (PGP fingerprint: A12B 3C4D 5E6F 7890 ABCD EF01 2345 6789 0ABC DEF1).' We'll attach that as attestation.pdf.

ArtifactBot: final bundle uploaded (1819002468/final-bundle-2026-06-10.zip) - files: audit.jsonl (1.1MB), manifest.sha256, manifest.sha256.sig, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1819002468/final-bundle-2026-06-10.zip

Priya (TrustBank Sec): Got it. We'll run the verification steps and confirm back. Appreciate the operator/job_id fields included.

Sam (AE): Thanks team! I'll schedule the verification call with TrustBank and mark the SIG item as 'provided'.
